objects.statement: ∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set.{u} X} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X], @IsClosed.{u} X inst s → @IsLocallyClosed.{u} X inst s

∀ {X : Type u} {p : X → Prop} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X],
  @IsClosed.{u} X inst (@Set.ofPred.{u} X fun a => p a) → @IsOpen.{u} X inst (@Set.ofPred.{u} X fun a => Not (p a))

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {s : Set.{u} X},
  @IsOpen.{u} X inst s → @IsClosed.{u} X inst (@Compl.compl.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instCompl.{u} X) s)
∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set.{u} X} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X], @IsOpen.{u} X inst s → @IsLocallyClosed.{u} X inst s

∀ {X : Type u} {f g : TopologicalSpace.{u} X},
  @Eq.{u + 1} (Set.{u} X → Prop) (@IsOpen.{u} X f) (@IsOpen.{u} X g) → @Eq.{u + 1} (TopologicalSpace.{u} X) f g

∀ {X : Type u} {t t' : TopologicalSpace.{u} X},
  Iff (@Eq.{u + 1} (TopologicalSpace.{u} X) t t') (∀ (s : Set.{u} X), Iff (@IsOpen.{u} X t s) (@IsOpen.{u} X t' s))

∀ {X : Type u_2} {t₁ t₂ : TopologicalSpace.{u_2} X},
  Iff (@Eq.{u_2 + 1} (TopologicalSpace.{u_2} X) t₁ t₂)
    (∀ (s : Set.{u_2} X), Iff (@IsClosed.{u_2} X t₁ s) (@IsClosed.{u_2} X t₂ s))

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {s : Set.{u} X},
  Iff (@IsClosed.{u} X inst (@Compl.compl.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instCompl.{u} X) s)) (@IsOpen.{u} X inst s)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {p : Prop}, @IsClosed.{u} X inst (@Set.ofPred.{u} X fun _x => p)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X],
  @IsClosed.{u} X inst (@EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instEmptyCollection.{u} X))

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {f : ι → Set.{u} X},
  (∀ (i : ι), @IsClosed.{u} X inst (f i)) → @IsClosed.{u} X inst (⋂ i, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] [Finite.{v} ι] {s : ι → Set.{u} X},
  (∀ (i : ι), @IsClosed.{u} X inst (s i)) → @IsClosed.{u} X inst (⋃ i, s i)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X], @IsClosed.{u} X inst (@Set.univ.{u} X)

∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set.{u} X} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X],
  Iff (@IsOpen.{u} X inst (@Compl.compl.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instCompl.{u} X) s)) (@IsClosed.{u} X inst s)
∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {p : Prop}, @IsOpen.{u} X inst (@Set.ofPred.{u} X fun _x => p)

∀ {X : Type u} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X],
  @IsOpen.{u} X inst (@EmptyCollection.emptyCollection.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instEmptyCollection.{u} X))

∀ {X : Type u} {s : Set.{u} X} {t : TopologicalSpace.{u} X},
  @Eq.{1} Prop (@TopologicalSpace.IsOpen.{u} X t s) (@IsOpen.{u} X t s)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] [Finite.{v} ι] {s : ι → Set.{u} X},
  (∀ (i : ι), @IsOpen.{u} X inst (s i)) → @IsOpen.{u} X inst (⋂ i, s i)

∀ {X : Type u} {ι : Sort v} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {f : ι → Set.{u} X},
  (∀ (i : ι), @IsOpen.{u} X inst (f i)) → @IsOpen.{u} X inst (⋃ i, f i)

∀ {X : Type u} {α : Type u_1} {s : Set.{u} X} [inst : TopologicalSpace.{u} X] {f : α → Set.{u} X},
  (∀ (i : α), @IsOpen.{u} X inst (f i)) →
    @Eq.{u + 1} (Set.{u} X) (⋃ i, f i) (@Set.univ.{u} X) →
      Iff (@IsOpen.{u} X inst s)
        (∀ (i : α), @IsOpen.{u} X inst (@Inter.inter.{u} (Set.{u} X) (@Set.instInter.{u} X) (f i) s))
